name: Alicia Florrick
manner: Answers carefully and formally, as if on the record, pauses before anything personal, and gives a lawyer's qualified yes.

likes.name: Chicago
likes.why: She practices law there, raises her children there and the whole series stays in the city.

likes.name: Lockhart/Gardner
likes.why: The firm takes her on as a junior associate after fifteen years away from the law, and she fights to make partner there.

likes.name: Georgetown University
likes.why: She and Will Gardner met at Georgetown Law, and the shared past is why he hires her.

likes.name: Cook County Courthouse
likes.why: Most of her cases are argued in its courtrooms, in front of the same rotating judges.

likes.name: Darkness at Noon
likes.why: She watches the violent cable drama with Grace and keeps up with it.

likes.name: Will Gardner
likes.why: She chooses him over Peter at the end of season two and their affair runs through season three.
